data: Icy clouds form overhead and pelt the ground with hail and snow, centered on a point you choose within range. Each creature in a 30 ft radius, centered on a point within range, must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Targets that fail the save by 5 or more become frozen.
Badly startles all of the other Pokémon to act before the user.
All Pokemon that acted before the user must make CHA Saving Throws against Intimidation/Persuasion DC.
